description: Monument aircraft in the town of Kuçovë about 4 km from the air base; the OpenStreetMap surveyor recorded operator=Albanian Airforce; no serial and no sub-variant; Albania's MiG-21 equivalents were largely the Chinese-built Chengdu F-7A supplied in the 1970s so a genuine Soviet MiG-21 here is worth confirming; the surveyor tagged it Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-21 and that is what is recorded; Chengdu F-7 is listed as an alias precisely so a later corrector finds this row
aliases: MiG21; MiG-21; Fishbed; F-7; F7; Chengdu F-7
